name: Forearm Plank
steps: Place forearms on the floor with elbows below the shoulders.
Step feet back and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Brace the abdomen and lightly squeeze the glutes.
Hold while breathing steadily, then lower the knees.
cues: Push the forearms into the floor.
Keep the ribs over the pelvis.
mistakes: Holding the breath or lifting the hips too high.
breathing: Take small, steady breaths throughout the hold.
